notes: Printed layout is separate side-by-side blocks per gas, each with H2O columns (literature ref. X, Ref. 8, Present study) and 2H2O columns (Present study, Ref. 8 or Ref. 14); restacked into two files: group1 = H2O, group2 = 2H2O, one label row per gas.
